g.text: Gather info, question users, identify changes,
Step 2: Establish a Theory of Probable Cause
Question the obvious, consider multiple approaches,
research based on symptoms (simple to complex)
Step 3: Test the Theory to Determine Cause
Confirm theory, test to verify root cause
If theory not confirmed, re-establish new theory
Step 4: Establish a Plan of Action
Plan the fix, notify affected users,
consider impacts, refer to vendor docs if needed
Step 5: Implement the Solution or Escalate
Apply fix, escalate if beyond expertise,
test to verify the solution works
